title: Up or Down · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Up or Down · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner prepares two comfortably hummed pitches, one higher and one lower. The partner hums them in a chosen order; the lead says whether the pitch rose or fell. The lead identifies the direction correctly. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Up or Down, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead identifies the direction correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The lead identifies the direction correctly.
